collection.description: An elder explains why snakes should be given room to move away.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), an elder, explains why snakes should be given room to move away. A quiet observer sketches the animal from memory afterward.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), an elder, explains why snakes should be given room to move away. Everyone keeps a respectful distance and lets the animal pass.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), an elder, explains why snakes should be given room to move away. (Name1) feels startled, then fascinated.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (Name1), an elder, explains why snakes should be given room to move away. The children ask more questions than the elder can answer.
